name: Haus Edmund
beschreibung:
The Haus Edmund is a traditional inn in Tirol, Österreich. It is located in a quiet setting, often with a view of the surrounding mountain scenery and close to hiking or ski areas. The rooms are practically furnished and generally offer the typical amenities of a country inn with private bathroom and balcony.

The in-house restaurant serves mainly regional cuisine of Tirol and places emphasis on seasonal ingredients. Guests can enjoy local specialties here in a cozy atmosphere. In the immediate vicinity there are numerous hiking trails in summer as well as cross-country ski trails and ski routes in winter. The special atmosphere of the house is characterized by family-like and authentic hospitality that preserves the traditional character of the inn. The furnishings often combine time-honored elements with modern comfort for a relaxing stay.
